name: magpie-harness-quota
description: Optional Magpie quota sources for external harness instances, plus an agy-cli account source that binds Magpie Antigravity accounts to named instances (Antigravity direct collector plus Grok Build, Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Qoder, and WorkBuddy via Magpie CLI).

interface.shortDescription: Read external harness account allowances via official Magpie CLI

magpiePath.title: Magpie executable
magpiePath.description: Optional absolute path to the official magpie[.exe] binary. Leave empty to resolve magpie from PATH.

zh.title: Magpie 可执行文件
zh.description: 可选的官方 magpie[.exe] 绝对路径；留空时从 PATH 查找。

antigravitySidecarPath.title: Antigravity scoped sidecar
antigravitySidecarPath.description: Absolute path to the MIT cockpit-cliproxy binary. Prepare starts it with --harness-scoped and --parent-pid. Leave empty until an agy-cli instance selects a Magpie Antigravity account. List does not start it.

zh.title: Antigravity 单账号 sidecar
zh.description: MIT cockpit-cliproxy 二进制的绝对路径。准备账号时以 --harness-scoped 和 --parent-pid 启动。在 agy-cli 实例选中 Magpie Antigravity 账号之前可以留空。列出账号不会启动它。

magpieConfigDir.title: Magpie config directory
magpieConfigDir.description: Optional absolute path to Magpie's config directory (containing logins.json and providers.json) for the built-in Antigravity direct collector. Leave empty to resolve via magpiePath / ~/.config/magpie.

zh.title: Magpie 配置目录
zh.description: 可选的 Magpie 配置目录绝对路径（含 logins.json 与 providers.json，供内置 Antigravity 直查收集器只读读取）；留空时按 magpiePath 或 ~/.config/magpie 解析。

antigravityOAuthClientId.title: Antigravity OAuth client ID
antigravityOAuthClientId.description: Ordinary OAuth client ID used only to refresh an expired Antigravity access token through that account's bound proxy. Leave empty when saved access tokens are still valid. Set this in Kiki's plugin settings or the process environment ANTIGRAVITY_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID. Do not put it in the plugin source.

zh.title: Antigravity OAuth 客户端 ID
zh.description: 仅在 Antigravity access token 过期时，经该账号绑定的代理刷新所用的普通客户端 ID。token 仍有效时可留空。在 Kiki 插件设置或进程环境变量 ANTIGRAVITY_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID 中填写，不要写入插件源码。

antigravityOAuthClientSecret.title: Antigravity OAuth client secret
antigravityOAuthClientSecret.description: Secret half of the refresh client. Kiki stores it as a plugin secret and injects it into harness quota reads. It is never written to this repository, process argv, or logs. Alternative: process environment ANTIGRAVITY_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET.

zh.title: Antigravity OAuth 客户端密钥
zh.description: 刷新所用客户端密钥。Kiki 按插件密钥保存，并在额度读取时注入。不会写入本仓库、进程 argv 或日志。也可使用进程环境变量 ANTIGRAVITY_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET。

modelWindows.title: Model window mappings (JSON)
modelWindows.description: Optional JSON object mapping exact native model IDs (or per-source maps keyed by source ID such as "codex" / "grok") to Magpie CLI pool/name windows.

zh.title: 模型额度池映射（JSON）
zh.description: 可选的 JSON 映射（支持扁平模型 ID 映射，或按来源 ID 如 "codex" / "grok" 分组），将精确原生模型 ID 映射到 Magpie CLI 的 pool/name 窗口。

tools.name: magpie_manage
tools.description: Structured, credential-safe Magpie management entry point. Inspects or updates Magpie accounts, global gateway account selection (explicitly distinguished from native CLI sign-in), native Grok single-token home/locator state, quota cards & 45-day history, token/session usage, model catalog & per-model settings (`magpie models` / `magpie model`), routing groups (`magpie groups` / `magpie group`), service/daemon/autostart controls (`magpie daemon` / `magpie autostart` / `magpie healthcheck`), redacted proxy bindings, public settings (`magpie settings`, credential-free proxy validation), provider pools, plugins (`magpie plugin`), and structured log file locators (`magpie log --path`). Never executes arbitrary shell commands, never starts proxy/daemon services unless explicitly invoked via `daemon_manage`, never returns raw log contents, and never returns tokens or API keys.

action.description: Structured management operation to run. Use "capabilities" to inspect all operations, subcommands, and side-effect scopes.

subcommand.description: Structured sub-operation for `model_manage` (`name | names | efforts | api | apis | context | output | spec | specs | wire | wires | id | ids | alias | aliases | disable | enable | disabled | suffix | compact`), `group_manage` (`show | add | set | pick | copy | rm | restore | auto | template`), `plugin_manage` (`add | rm | update | on | off | options | use | move | builtin | preset | registry | dump`), `daemon_manage` (`status | install | uninstall | start | stop | restart | web`), or `autostart_manage` (`status | on | off`).

provider.description: Optional Magpie provider ID for quota/pool/model/plugin actions.

account.description: Account selector (12-char accountHash from accounts_list/grok_native_status, alias, or exact Magpie account label; "next" supported on accounts_switch for codex/claude).

target.description: Target identifier for quota_history, model_manage (`<provider/model>` or model ID), group_manage (`<group-id>` or group name), or plugin_manage (`<plugin-name>` or package spec).

targets.description: Optional list of target IDs (for example multiple models in `model_manage` `disable`/`enable`/`api`, or multiple group/provider IDs in `group_manage` `rm`/`auto`).

name.description: Display name or new group/model alias name for `model_manage` or `group_manage`.

alias.description: Display alias to set in accounts_alias or model_manage alias.

clear.description: When true in accounts_alias, clears the account’s custom alias.

reset.description: When true in model_manage or plugin_manage (`options` / `registry`), resets the target setting to its default (`--reset` / `off` / `default`).

enabled.description: Boolean toggle for accounts_switch_only, accounts_discovery, group_manage (`auto`), plugin_manage (`builtin`), daemon_manage (`web`), or autostart_manage.

nativeGrokHome.description: Optional absolute path override for the native Grok home directory (defaults to GROK_HOME or ~/.grok).

period.description: Calendar period preset for usage_summary or sessions_summary.

days.description: Rolling window in days for quota_history (1..45), usage_summary, or sessions_summary.

last.description: Rolling duration for usage_summary (for example "24h" or "90m").

model.description: Model identifier (`<provider/model>` or bare model ID) for sessions_summary, model_manage, or group_manage `pick`.

models.description: Ordered member model IDs or patterns for `group_manage` (`add` / `set`).

modelsAdd.description: Member model IDs or patterns to append (`models+=`) in `group_manage` `set`.

modelsRemove.description: Member model IDs or patterns to remove (`models-=`) in `group_manage` `set`.

routing.description: Routing strategy for `group_manage` (`smart | order | rotate | usage | pace | weight | free | fast | cheap | drain | expiring | manual`).

stays.description: Session affinity (`stays`) for `group_manage` (`auto | session | turn | off | strict`).

efforts.description: Reasoning effort levels (`none | minimal | low | medium | high | xhigh | max`) for `model_manage` (`efforts` / `spec`) or `group_manage` (`set` `levels=`).

contextTokens.description: Context window size (for example `"200000"`, `"272k"`, `"1m"`, `"smallest"`) for `model_manage` or `group_manage`.

outputTokens.description: Max output token limit (for example `"128k"` or `"64000"`) for `model_manage`.

vision.description: Optional vision capability toggle (`--vision on|off`) for `model_manage` (`subcommand="spec"`).

folder.description: Optional workspace folder filter for sessions_summary.

key.description: Public setting key from Magpie’s `settingsapi.Keys` registry for settings_get, settings_set, or settings_reset.

value.description: Setting value for settings_set, or value for `model_manage` (`suffix` / `compact`).

cap.description: Optional per-account usage cap percentage (1..100 or "off") for provider_pool.
